World Municipal Law
	

Local (municipal / county / water-board / regional) law worldwide, normalized to one schema. Companion to
endomorphosis/american_municipal_law,
which stays unchanged.

Since 2026-10-11, national, subnational (first-level: state / Land / province / région) and supranational law,
